title: Contextual AI Integration Tools
summary: This module provides specialized tools for interacting with the Contextual AI platform. It enables the creation of RAG agents with document ingestion, parsing of various document types, and querying of existing Contextual AI agents.

nodes.label: Create Contextual AI Agent
nodes.title: ContextualAICreateAgentTool
nodes.description: Creates a new Contextual AI RAG agent, ingesting specified documents into a datastore for retrieval-augmented generation.

nodes.label: Parse Documents with Contextual AI
nodes.title: ContextualAIParseTool
nodes.description: Utilizes Contextual AI's advanced parser to process documents, extracting structured information and converting them into various output formats.

nodes.label: Query Contextual AI Agent
nodes.title: ContextualAIQueryTool
nodes.description: Allows querying of an existing Contextual AI RAG agent, retrieving relevant information based on the agent's configured knowledge base.

nodes.label: Contextual AI Python Client
nodes.title: Contextual AI Client Library
nodes.description: The official Python client library for programmatic interaction with the Contextual AI platform's services.

nodes.label: Local File Storage
nodes.title: Local File System
nodes.description: Represents the local file system where documents are stored before being uploaded or parsed by the tools.

nodes.label: Contextual AI Cloud Platform
nodes.title: Contextual AI Service
nodes.description: The external cloud-based AI service that hosts RAG agents, datastores, and document parsing capabilities.

groups.label: Agent Operations
groups.title: Contextual AI Agent Management
groups.description: Tools focused on the lifecycle and interaction with Contextual AI RAG agents.

groups.label: Document Processing
groups.title: Contextual AI Document Parsing
groups.description: Tool dedicated to leveraging Contextual AI's capabilities for document analysis and parsing.

groups.label: Integration Layer
groups.title: Contextual AI Client Integration
groups.description: The core library facilitating communication between the tools and the Contextual AI platform.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Data and AI Services
groups.description: External systems that the Contextual AI tools interact with for data input and AI processing.
